notes: The laning phase, 1:45 into a match -- which is when detection is most
likely to be run, and a different UI state from the other fixtures.
Deadlock marks all four players in the lane here, not just you: your
team's colour behind two slots and the enemy's behind the other two.
That broke self-detection, which had been comparing the best slot with
the runner-up. With four slots lit the runner-up is a lane-mate sitting
close behind (8.9 against 6.6 here), so the test threw out a correct
answer. Comparing against the median slot instead holds in both phases.
Only Ivy is player-confirmed -- they named it as the hero they were
playing. The other heroes listed are the detector's own reading at 0.53
or better and were spot-checked by eye, but they are not independent
ground truth. Victor and Dynamo are deliberately left out: both came in
around 0.32, which the matcher itself reports as uncertain.
